title: Crispy Peruvian Pork Knuckle
description: A traditional Peruvian dish made with a crispy pork knuckle, served with a side of stew.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the nutty seasoning.
Rub the seasoning mixture all over the pork knuckle, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork knuckle until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pork knuckle to a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue roasting for another 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is crispy and golden brown.
While the pork is cooking, heat the silky stew in a saucepan over low heat.
To serve, slice the pork knuckle and serve with a side of silky stew.
